onsite_generation: Rooftop solar PV above admin/office areas 'to be further explored'; Air Source Heat Pumps for office heating/cooling
methodology: Emerging UK Net Zero Carbon Building Standard used to set EUI targets; PUE stated as a design focus of 'less than 1.3, trending downwards'
assumptions: Free-cooling air-cooled chillers with variable speed compressors for data halls; design intent to enable future waste-heat export to a district heating network (none currently exists nearby; Heriot-Watt campus identified by the council as a future heat network)
notes: No annual GWh figure published in the documents reviewed; peak load taken as the 200 MW 'demand utility capacity' from the PAN description. GHG report (Nov 2025) covers whole-life carbon to BS EN 15978/RICS PS V2 over a 60-year reference period; results tables were not machine-readable in the FOI copy.

Kevin Williamson (Bella Caledonia) lists Wester Hermiston at 200-250 MW and argues the two Edinburgh proposals combined would exceed the domestic electricity consumption of every household in Edinburgh and Glasgow; no annual GWh stated.
